baseline_policy_frozen.note: Historical baseline policy E must reuse verbatim except frozen signal source (Kronos-mini zero-shot). Any execution/cost/threshold change = FAIL.

S1_frozen_policy_only.description: E used ONLY prespecified frozen policy: diff its config vs historical baseline policy
